lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Tell me again what he was doing with the rake.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: He was like pushing the stuff around so he can put more stuff on it so it’s even.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Show me what he was doing, you showed me the other day. Can you show me again?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Going like that? What kinda stuff was he pushing around?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Was he pushing her around at all?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Were you able to see her in the fire?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Just the forehead and the hands and the feet and a little bit of belly.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK. Sometime during that evening, um, did someone come down to Steven’s trailer or in that area?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You don’t you remember seeing, do you remember seeing anyone come down there, an-an-and talk to Steven for a bit?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Do you know if anyone else saw anything?
